teaser.en: Its frilly, purple-spotted flowers hang down like orchids, among the showiest in the coastal forest.
teaser.sw: Maua yake yenye mapindo na madoa ya zambarau huning'inia kama okidi, miongoni mwa maua ya kuvutia zaidi katika msitu wa pwani.

summary.en: *Mkwele* is a small tree of coastal forest and thicket with spectacular hanging flowers, frilly and yellow with purple spots. It belongs to the custard-apple family and bears round, hard-shelled fruit.
summary.sw: *Mkwele* ni mti mdogo wa misitu na vichaka vizito vya pwani wenye maua ya kustaajabisha yanayoning'inia, yenye mapindo na ya manjano yenye madoa ya zambarau. Ni wa familia ya mitopetope na huzaa matunda ya mviringo yenye ganda gumu.

about.en:
*Mkwele* is a small tree with drooping branches. When it flowers, it is hard to miss: large, showy blooms hang down on long stalks, with frilly petals of yellow spotted with purple. They are followed by round fruits with a hard shell.

Its bark is pale, which gave it one of its Digo names.
about.sw:
*Mkwele* ni mti mdogo wenye matawi yanayoinama. Unapochanua, ni vigumu kuukosa: maua makubwa ya kuvutia huning'inia kwenye vikonyo virefu, yakiwa na petali zenye mapindo za manjano zenye madoa ya zambarau. Baadaye huja matunda ya mviringo yenye ganda gumu.

Gome lake ni jeupe-jeupe, na hilo ndilo lililoupa mojawapo ya majina yake ya Kidigo.

where.en: It grows in coastal forest and thicket.
where.sw: Hukua katika misitu na vichaka vizito vya pwani.

uses.en: No particular use for *mkwele* has been recorded.

names.en: Pakia records the Digo name *mkwele*, also spelt *mkele*, which is shared with Duruma and Giriama. A second name is *mlala mwereru*, 'white *mlala*', for its pale bark, as opposed to *mlala mwiru*, *Diospyros kabuyeana*. The Mgombato dictionary uses *mlala* for the raffia palm, so the word has more than one meaning. No Swahili or English name is recorded.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi jina la Kidigo *mkwele*, pia huandikwa *mkele*, ambalo linatumika pia kwa Kiduruma na Kigiriama. Jina la pili ni *mlala mwereru*, '*mlala* mweupe', kwa sababu ya gome lake jeupe-jeupe, tofauti na *mlala mwiru*, *Diospyros kabuyeana*. Kamusi ya Mgombato inatumia *mlala* kwa mwale, hivyo neno hili lina maana zaidi ya moja. Hakuna jina la Kiswahili wala la Kiingereza lililorekodiwa.

reason.en: Isolona, a close relative in the same family
reason.sw: Isolona, jamaa wa karibu wa familia moja

reason.sw: Mti wa msituni wa familia ya mitopetope
